nom: Curology Dark Spot Corrector Serum with Niacinamide for Acne Marks

avis.texte: I’ve used one bottle so far. Ordered 2 more bottles. I think it’s working with my adapalene. I’m going to use two more bottles before really reviewing it. I like the ingredient list.

avis.titre: Effective treatment for dark age spots!
avis.texte: Love Curology! and this dark spot fade serum is no exception! It’s a great size, you only need one pump so I expect it will last a long time. It goes on smooth and absorbs quickly. Feels good on the skin and helps reduce both redness and age spots so they are not so noticeable and easier to cover to makeup.
I searched far and wide for a serum containing all of these ingredients, and I finally found curology’s dark spot serum. Phenomenal product with phenomenal results in just weeks!

This product works great. I’m on my second bottle of it and I can tell the difference in my skin tone . It’s not completely spot free yet but I can certainly tell that the area of concern has lightened up
Buy it. I struggled with the worst & most stubborn acne spots. Applying this consistently day and night helped me clear up my face for the summer. This is the product you need.

avis.titre: Amazon wouldn't post my original stellar 5 star
avis.texte: Look, buy it. The product works. I'm not going to rewrite my review when they're was nothing wrong with it to begin with. I use 3 other curology products in conjuction with this one. It works well for the combination I use.

I will have to update on results. But upon first uses, I can say that it feels amazing on the skin. Super soft and silky texture, doesn't feel heavy, greasy or sticky. It has a medium consistency, off white color and a faint scent of maybe crayons or plastic idk but it's not strong and I had to really hold it up to my nose to even detect a scent. I felt no irritation, no burning or anything. Definitely think this would layer well with other products, it's just super lightweight. Excited to see results, the ingredients all seem amazing and fantastic for dark spots.
Did not fade the dark spots or help with any uneven spots ,wrinkles or creases. Sadly
